name: Protagonist
source:
You play as a hard-working and studious investigator of the Public Security Intelligence Agency. You've always played by the rules and upheld conventional standards although you've always been curious about trying something more dangerous.

You're probably not gay, you've just always thought that girls are just really gorgeous and so soft, especially when their hand grazes yours... It doesn't really matter what you fantasize about in your head, that's sooo not the real you... Right?
